title: 第15章 柳嫣然的心声第16章 太苍武王万里血河掌
content_zh:
第15章柳嫣然的心声
“嗯。”
柳嫣然轻轻点头。
“你为何会与苏墨交手？”
林尘凝视着她，心情复杂。
柳嫣然温柔一笑：“苏墨老贼欺你，我怎么能放过他！”
“当时，我得知你武魂被废，被逐出宗门，便立刻赶来灵剑宗寻你，顺便找苏墨讨个说法。”
“我找了好久，找不到你，便与苏墨定下赌约，只要能接下他一掌，他就告诉我，你的去向。”
“苏墨老贼很自负，也很不要脸，他一掌没能打死我，却没有履行赌约。”
“还好，我后来终于找到你了。”
柳嫣然轻声细语，眼神温柔。
闻言，林尘心中百感交集。
“嫣然，你为何不让武极宗长辈出面？”
“当时师尊在闭关修炼，我不想打扰他，便自己来了。”
柳嫣然轻声道。
林尘心中感动，原来，柳嫣然默默为他做了这么多！
柳嫣然说得轻巧，但，苏墨是灵海九重巅峰的强者，她对其对战，其中艰辛，可想而知。
当日，柳嫣然带林尘回到武极宗以后，便匆匆去闭关。
如今看来，她闭关根本不是为了修炼，而是去疗伤。
“嫣然，谢谢！”

林尘心中有很多话想多，但终究没有说出口。
最难消受美人恩。
“林公子，都是过去的事了，不用想太多的。”
“我们是好朋友，而且定下了婚约，应该互相帮助的。”
柳嫣然美丽的脸上，露出一抹动人笑容。
“嫣然，别说话了，我助你逼出蝎毒。”
林尘面色沉凝，体内灵力爆发而出。
“林公子，不必为我损耗太多灵力，我没有大碍。”
柳嫣然急道。
林尘并未回应，直接召唤出至尊神龙武魂！
一道血色龙影，盘旋在林尘身边，恐怖的武魂威压释放而出。
柳嫣然脸色微变，没想到，林尘竟然能再度觉醒武魂！
content_en:
Chapter 15 Liu Yanran’s thoughts
"Yeah."
Liu Yanran nodded lightly.
"Why did you fight with Su Mo?"
Lin Chen stared at her with mixed emotions.
Liu Yanran smiled softly: "The old thief Su Mo is bullying you, how can I let him go!"
"At that time, when I learned that your martial soul was abolished and expelled from the sect, I immediately came to Lingjian Sect to find you, and asked Su Mo for an explanation."
"I searched for you for a long time and couldn't find you, so I made a bet with Su Mo. As long as I can take one of his palms, he will tell me your whereabouts."
"Old thief Su Mo is very arrogant and shameless. He couldn't kill me with one palm, but he didn't fulfill the bet."
"Fortunately, I finally found you later."
Liu Yanran spoke softly, with gentle eyes.
Hearing this, Lin Chen had mixed feelings in his heart.
"Yanran, why don't you let the elders of Wuji Sect come forward?"
"The master was practicing in seclusion at that time. I didn't want to disturb him, so I came here myself."
Liu Yanran said softly.
Lin Chen was moved. It turned out that Liu Yanran had silently done so much for him!
Liu Yanran said it lightly, but Su Mo was a strong man at the peak of the ninth level of the Linghai. You can imagine the hardships in fighting against him.
That day, after Liu Yanran brought Lin Chen back to Wuji Sect, they hurriedly went to retreat.
Now it seems that her seclusion is not for cultivation at all, but to heal her wounds.
"Yanran, thank you!"
Lin Chen had many things to say in his heart, but he never said them out.
It is most difficult to accept the kindness of a beautiful woman.
"Mr. Lin, it's all in the past. There's no need to think too much about it."
"We are good friends and have made an engagement. We should help each other."
A touching smile appeared on Liu Yanran's beautiful face.
"Yanran, stop talking, I'll help you force out the scorpion poison."
Lin Chen's face was solemn, and the spiritual power in his body burst out.
"Mr. Lin, don't waste too much spiritual power on me, I'm fine."
Liu Yanran said anxiously.
Lin Chen did not respond and directly summoned the Supreme Divine Dragon Spirit!
A bloody dragon shadow hovered around Lin Chen, and the terrifying pressure of the martial spirit was released.
Liu Yanran's expression changed slightly. She didn't expect that Lin Chen could awaken his martial spirit again!
